text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Major projects in Bahrain have to submit an environment impact assessment report to the government.
- International experts, exhibitors in second fire and safety conference in Bahrain.
- Plans for Bahrain's new 125 million dinar port and industrial zone were given the green light by the cabinet.
- Bahrain to forge new India links when the labour and social affairs minister visits India on Thursday.
